index.title: Pixelorbits — Website, App & SaaS Design and Development Studio
index.description: Pixelorbits is a design and development studio in Bareilly, India. We design and build websites, mobile apps, SaaS products and e-commerce stores for startups and brands in the UK, US, Australia and India.

fasto.title: Fasto Case Study — Delivery App Design & React Native Development | Pixelorbits
fasto.description: How Pixelorbits moved a Delhi student delivery business off WhatsApp with a customer app, delivery partner app, admin panel and website, built in React Native in about two months.

crm.title: Sales CRM Case Study — Replacing Excel with a Custom CRM | Pixelorbits
crm.description: How Pixelorbits designed a custom sales CRM for an IT services company that outgrew Excel and Google Sheets: one six-step lead flow with follow-ups, GST billing and outcomes.

resume.title: Resume Builder SaaS Case Study — Product Design & Development | Pixelorbits
resume.description: How Pixelorbits designed and built a resume builder SaaS with a guided editor, live preview, screening-friendly templates and PDF export.

audio.title: Audio Creator Platform Case Study — Web App Design & Development | Pixelorbits
audio.description: How Pixelorbits built a mobile-first web app for recording, publishing and sharing audio stories, with creator profiles, an explore feed and share cards.

vehicles.title: Vehicle Marketplace App Case Study — iOS App Design & Development | Pixelorbits
vehicles.description: How Pixelorbits designed and built a marketplace app for buying and selling pre-owned cars, bikes, boats, buses and heavy equipment, with category-based filters.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp Business API Platform Case Study — SaaS Development | Pixelorbits
whatsapp.description: How Pixelorbits built a WhatsApp Business API platform with a shared team inbox, broadcasts, a chatbot builder and reports.

fashion.title: Fashion E-commerce Store Case Study — Custom Store Design & Development | Pixelorbits
